name: Vichnyy tanetsʹ
source:
Maxim, a successful student in everything, found his passion - he is the leader of a popular clan and the main pioneer in the new MMO. Maxim's abilities allowed him to understand the secrets of 11 of the 12 legendary monoliths that no one else had succumbed to. But getting closer to solving the last monolith, he learns the truth that will change his whole life...

[Translated from [url=https://plugara.itch.io/eternal-dance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
马克西姆是一个各方面都很成功的学生，他找到了自己的激情——他是一个受欢迎的部落的领导者，也是新MMO的主要先驱。马克西姆的能力让他了解了12块传奇巨石中11块的秘密，而其他人都没有屈服过。但当他越来越接近解决最后一块巨石时，他了解到了将改变他一生的真相……

[译自[url=https://plugara.itch.io/eternal-dance]itch.io[/url]]
